import json, subprocess, inspect, sys
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service import liveness

head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
print("head="+head)
print("=== _report_stall source ===")
print(inspect.getsource(liveness._report_stall))

title="[do-again] No-progress after bounded continuation (do-again)"
commands=[
  ["gh","issue","list","--repo","Tran-Steven/do-again","--state","open","--limit","100","--search",f"{title} in:title","--json","number,title"],
  ["gh","issue","list","--repo","Tran-Steven/do-again","--state","open","--limit","100","--json","number,title"],
  ["gh","search","issues","--repo","Tran-Steven/do-again","--state","open","--match","title",title,"--json","number,title"],
]
for i,cmd in enumerate(commands,1):
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,timeout=30)
    print(f"=== command {i} rc={p.returncode} ===")
    print("argv="+json.dumps(cmd))
    print("stdout="+p.stdout)
    print("stderr="+p.stderr)

print("READ_ONLY_STALL_DEDUPE_DIAGNOSTIC_OK")
